advancements.pixelpirates.root.title: Pixel Pirates
advancements.pixelpirates.root.descripti: Ten bosses, five seas, one Leviathan. Set sail.
advancements.pixelpirates.got_sea_legs.d: Craft a raft and take to the water
advancements.pixelpirates.shark_bait.des: Get eaten by a shark. You really thought you could swim out here?
advancements.pixelpirates.meet_the_merch: Find and speak to the Map Merchant
advancements.pixelpirates.eyes_on_the_ho: Buy the Ship Radar from the Map Merchant
advancements.pixelpirates.x_marks_the_sp: Dig up treasure with a treasure map
advancements.pixelpirates.hammock_time.d: Sling a hammock and set your spawn
advancements.pixelpirates.full_pirate_ki: Suit up in a complete set of pirate armour
advancements.pixelpirates.money_well_spe: Commission a ship from the Shipwright on the grand pier
advancements.pixelpirates.captain_now.de: Take the helm and steer your own ship
advancements.pixelpirates.broadside.desc: Load a cannon and fire a broadside
advancements.pixelpirates.she_holds.desc: Patch your hull with a Ship Repair Kit
advancements.pixelpirates.home_at_sea.de: Set your respawn on a Ship Bedroll aboard your vessel
data.pixelpirates.world.title: Pixel Pirates
tooltip.pixelpirates.soulrender.lore: It drinks so you don't bleed
tooltip.pixelpirates.wraithblade.ability: Withers foes. Right-click: Phantom Rush dash (12s)
tooltip.pixelpirates.kraken_fang.ability: Venomous - poisons and slows on hit
tooltip.pixelpirates.kraken_fang.lore: Pried from a jaw the size of a sloop
tooltip.pixelpirates.stormcaller.ability: Right-click: Tempest - lightning where you aim (20s)
tooltip.pixelpirates.stormcaller.lore: The storm answers to no captain but one
tooltip.pixelpirates.abyssal_harpoon.abi: Right-click: The Reel - drag your target to you (8s)
tooltip.pixelpirates.abyssal_harpoon.lor: What the abyss hooks, it keeps
tooltip.pixelpirates.set_bonus.navy_offi: Set Bonus: Hero of the Village
tooltip.pixelpirates.set_bonus.kraken_sc: Set Bonus: Conduit Power + Dolphin's Grace
tooltip.pixelpirates.diving_charm.lore: The old captain never feared the deep - he just never went there
tooltip.pixelpirates.tide_pearl: Scalding seas can't burn you; +50% damage to fire creatures that fear water
tooltip.pixelpirates.tide_pearl.lore: Still cold from the trench floor
tooltip.pixelpirates.lantern: Immune to Darkness and Blindness; undead within 24 blocks glow
tooltip.pixelpirates.lantern.lore: Forged in the Warlord's heart-fire. Ghosts cannot hide from it
tooltip.pixelpirates.anchor: Immune to Abyss madness and Mining Fatigue; Conduit Power underwater
tooltip.pixelpirates.anchor.lore: It held the Ghost Captain to this world. Now it holds you
tooltip.pixelpirates.tide_sigil: Pulls and whirlpools can't move you; no Slowness; Dolphin's Grace
tooltip.pixelpirates.tide_sigil.lore: The tides bow to whoever bears the King's seal
tooltip.pixelpirates.razor_tooth: Grabs can't hold you; +50% damage to rooted creatures
tooltip.pixelpirates.razor_tooth.lore: Cuts through tentacle as easily as through rope
tooltip.pixelpirates.ink_heart.lore: Black ink runs where the rot would spread
tooltip.pixelpirates.shackle: Your hits stop bosses healing for 8s; immune to Poison
tooltip.pixelpirates.shackle.lore: What once bound the dead now binds the living
tooltip.pixelpirates.heartstone: Opens the Leviathan's Rift; immune to Weakness; Resistance I underwater
tooltip.pixelpirates.heartstone.lore: It still beats. Something far below beats back
tooltip.pixelpirates.tidebreaker: Cracks Tideward Stones - each one strips a scale from the Sea Serpent
tooltip.pixelpirates.tidebreaker.lore: Coral-forged by the shrine keepers, who knew what slept in the trench
tooltip.pixelpirates.crown: Water breathing, Dolphin's Grace, Conduit Power and night vision in the sea
tooltip.pixelpirates.crown.lore: It wore the bells of two towns. Now you wear it
advancements.pixelpirates.island_fare.de: Eat a banana - pick a ripe bunch with right-click and it grows back
advancements.pixelpirates.patched_up.des: Make a Sea Bandage from paper, string and kelp
advancements.pixelpirates.ship_cook.desc: Eat any dish from the galley
Eat a Salmagundi - a bit of everything
advancements.pixelpirates.master_of_the_: Eat ten signature dishes: banana pudding, seaweed salad, shark jerky, fish and chips, coconut curry, key lime pie, scurvy tonic, parrotfish poke, ember eel skewer and anglerfry chowder
advancements.pixelpirates.powder_key.des: Get your hands on dynamite - only a blast clears Blast Rubble, and every vault is sealed with it
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_captain_r: Defeat Captain Rackham in his island fort. The Merchant Seas (Zone 2) open
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_sea_serpe: Break the Tideward Stones and defeat the Sea Serpent. The Pirate Seas (Zone 3) open
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_molten_wa: Defeat the Molten Warlord in the Cinder Citadel. The Cursed Seas (Zone 4) open
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_ghost_cap: Ring the phantom bell, sink the Flying Dutchman and defeat its captain. The Abyss (Zone 5) opens
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_abyssal_k: Drain the Sunken Court and defeat the Abyssal King
Pin the Bloodfin with a whaler's harpoon and kill it
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_kraken.de: Sever its arms, then defeat the Kraken
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_chained_r: Pull the Gallowbrand and defeat the Chained Revenant
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_abyssal_h: Stop the Abyssal Heart. The Leviathan's Rift opens
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_leviathan: Hunt the Leviathan across three lairs and slay it
advancements.pixelpirates.forged_in_vict: Forge a boss's relic into its weapon - it keeps the relic's power
advancements.pixelpirates.boss_ward.desc: Find a piece of boss armour in a boss's hoard
advancements.pixelpirates.mantle_of_thal: Own the full Mantle of Thalassar
advancements.pixelpirates.gone_fishing.d: Catch one of the seas' own fish
Catch every fish of the five seas

advancements.pixelpirates.yo_ho_ho.descr: Age a bottle of rum to Vintage
advancements.pixelpirates.hideout.title: Pirate Hideout
advancements.pixelpirates.hideout.descri: Raise a Jolly Roger to claim a hideout
Forge a blade on a Forge Anvil
advancements.pixelpirates.master_smith.d: Forge every one of the smith's patterns
